All constructions

Every record, grouped by problem, with links to the record file, its exact certificate and its float check on GitHub. Open a problem to see its 39 values of n.

All 2,145 records on this site are certified exactly. The same files are in records/; SUMMARY.csv and SUMMARY_families.csv list every value with all digits, and data/records.json holds everything shown on this site. Download the whole repository.
